site_name: Glenbervie Business Park / land northeast of Glenbervie Nursery
address: Land to the northeast of Glenbervie Nursery, Stirling Road (Glenbervie Business Park, Bellsdyke Road), Larbert

site_area_m2.notes: 55 acres per Apatura press release (converted); consultation site describes 'around 50 acres of mainly vacant grassland'. Red-line area not verified.

gross_floor_area_m2.notes: Two data centre buildings; excludes the 11,500 m2 electricity substation.

max_building_height_m.notes: 25 m building height with flues extending to 28 m.

number_of_buildings.notes: Two data centre buildings plus an 11,500 m2 electricity substation and associated facilities.

current_land_use: Mainly vacant grassland beside Glenbervie Business Park, allocated for business and industry use in the local development plan (developer description)
land_notes: Land reported to be owned by Scottish Enterprise. Site is south of the M876. Objectors state the site is close to housing, a care home (reported ~20 m away), a nursery and Forth Valley Royal Hospital; distances not verified against application drawings. The scheme was relocated here from agricultural land near Plean, Stirling (~3 miles away) in October 2025. Coordinates are an approximate placement of the Glenbervie Business Park area, not taken from a plan.
